title: CISA Warns of Active Attacks on Two Critical PHP2Shell Flaws
excerpt: CISA has added two PHP2Shell vulnerabilities to its KEV catalog following confirmation of active exploitation.
body_html:
The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency has confirmed that two recently patched PHP2Shell vulnerabilities are currently facing active exploitation in the wild. Consequently, the agency has added these security flaws to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.

Both vulnerabilities carry a high severity rating of 9.2 on the CVSS scoring system. According to details, these flaws allow unauthenticated remote code execution on impacted deployments. Among the added issues is an out-of-memory vulnerability tracked as CVE-2026-109618.

Administrators and organizations using affected deployments are advised to review the catalog entries and apply the necessary patches provided by developers to protect their systems from potential attacks.
